steps.title: Implement basic interval service generator
steps.instruction: Develop a utility class to automatically generate repeating hourly and sub-hourly train schedules for a defined route, taking into account block occupancy times.
steps.acceptance: The service generator must output a valid sequence of departure and arrival events for all simulated stations, maintaining the requested headway without conflicts.
steps.result: I have created the initial schedule-generator class and defined the data structures for route segments. I am currently implementing the headway calculation algorithm to prevent overlapping blocks. The basic test suite is being written to verify simple linear routes.
